paragraphs: In [Beitzah 5b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.5b.9) he and Rav Shalman of Bei Kelochit both say, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli calls both sages Rav and says both are from Bei Kelochit. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=239&lang=en) instead abbreviates Shalman’s title as ר׳.
